clause_text: Tenant agrees that the entire security deposit of $2,000 shall be deemed non-refundable and forfeited in full if Tenant vacates before the 12-month term, regardless of whether Landlord immediately re-rents the unit.
Landlord shall return the security deposit within twenty-one (21) days of surrender of the premises, together with an itemized accounting of any deductions for damages exceeding normal wear and tear.

Landlord and Landlord's agents reserve the absolute right to enter the leased premises at any time 24/7 without prior notice for routine inspections, maintenance, or showing the unit to prospective buyers.

Landlord shall provide at least twenty-four (24) hours advance written notice prior to entering the premises for inspections or non-emergency repairs during regular business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM).
Rent is due on the 1st of the month. If not received by 5:00 PM on the 1st, a late fee of $75 per day shall accumulate until all overdue rent is received in full. There is no grace period.

clause_title: Standard Late Fee with Grace Period
clause_text: If rent is received after the fifth (5th) day of the calendar month, Tenant shall pay a flat late fee of $40. No additional daily penalties shall accrue.

clause_title: Habitability Waiver and Major HVAC Shift
clause_text: Tenant explicitly waives any and all implied warranties of habitability and agrees to bear full financial cost for replacing or repairing the roof, furnace, and HVAC system during the tenancy.
expected_concerns: Tenant pays major structural and HVAC replacement

clause_text: Landlord agrees to maintain the roof, foundation, exterior walls, and plumbing and electrical systems in safe operating condition. Tenant is responsible for replacing standard light bulbs and keeping the unit clean.

Tenant agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Landlord against any and all claims, bodily injuries, or damages occurring on the property, even if caused by Landlord's own gross negligence or willful misconduct.
expected_concerns: Indemnification of landlord's own gross negligence

clause_text: Each party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other party from and against claims and liabilities arising directly from the indemnifying party's negligent acts or material breach of this Lease.

In the event Borrower pays off this promissory note prior to maturity, Borrower shall pay a prepayment penalty equal to all remaining unearned interest through the 5-year term. Failure to pay on the due date triggers immediate acceleration without notice.
expected_concerns: Punitive prepayment penalty charging all future unearned interest

clause_text: Borrower may prepay the principal amount of this loan in whole or in part at any time without penalty or premium. Lender shall apply prepayments directly to principal reduction.
The loan shall bear interest at an annual percentage rate (APR) of 48% compounded monthly. Any late installment shall trigger a default APR of 65%.
expected_concerns: Interest rate exceeds statutory usury limits (48% APR)

clause_text: The unpaid principal shall accrue simple interest at a fixed rate of 6.25% per annum computed on a 365-day basis.
Subletting is strictly prohibited under any circumstances. Any attempt to sublet or host an unauthorized guest for more than 48 hours shall result in immediate eviction and a $1,500 penalty fee.
Tenant may sublet the premises with the prior written consent of Landlord, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed for qualified applicants.

clause_title: Automatic Lease Renewal and Strict Notice
clause_text: This lease shall automatically renew for an additional 12 months at a 15% rent increase unless Tenant provides certified written notice to vacate at least ninety (90) days prior to expiration.
Either party may terminate this agreement at the conclusion of the initial term by providing thirty (30) days advance written notice.

clause_title: Standard Joint and Several Liability Boilerplate
clause_text: If more than one Tenant signs this Lease, the obligations of each Tenant shall be joint and several liability for all rent and covenants under this Agreement.
expected_concerns: Standard boilerplate often mistaken for predatory

clause_text: If any provision of this Lease is held invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such invalidity shall not affect the validity or enforceability of any other provision.
